description: Paid: fetch a public URL and return its cited, paragraph-addressable text with integrity hashes and a receipt. Uses one prepaid credit, and only when extraction succeeds. Needs a ProofFetch key sent as the MCP request header Authorization: Bearer <key> (buy one at the ProofFetch home page). Run proof_fetch_preflight first. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/"}.

idempotencyKey.description: Recommended. Send the same key when retrying so a retry never uses a second credit; without it every call is a new purchase.

maxChars.description: Maximum normalized characters to extract. Free preflight returns metadata plus a preview of about the first 1,000 characters.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) document URL. No credentials, private networks, authenticated pages or browser rendering.

name: proof_fetch_evidence
